notes: Backend was not running during this crawl; Next.js returns 500 for every proxied API call. Those errors are counted separately and do NOT indicate a broken page.
Use firstContentfulPaint / loadEventEnd as the real UI latency. The crawl_wallclock_* figures include a deliberate 2500 ms settle sleep and are NOT valid latency measurements.
Measured against a local production build (next start) on the same machine, not a deployed/CDN environment.
firstContentfulPaint n < total because Chromium only emits a paint entry for pages that paint before the observation window closes.
